title: DP-1 Content Rating Extension
description: Optional signed, per-item audience labels and open-vocabulary curatorial reasons.

contentRating.description: Curatorial audience label. Values defined by v0.1.0: general, mature. Absence, or a value the consumer does not recognize, means unrated; nothing is assumed from an unknown label. Non-string values are invalid.

contentReasons.description: Optional open-vocabulary curatorial reasons supporting contentRating. Consumers must not treat values as a closed protocol taxonomy.
